choices.say: she looks like the instrument. u sound like it. is it priscilla ur scared of, or the 3 strangers w/ the clipboard?
ok but forget saturday for a sec. do u even LIKE doing it every sunday?

22 years. a different bow tie every day but the same idea. n i just thought of the violas clapping. they clapped w/ the hair RIGHT THERE in the front. hmm

effects.text: misery is finding out that mr alvarado's bow tie is a philosophy. 22 years. nobody has ever asked him to lose it. rawr

like what if the hair is the whole sentence n the cello is just the period. what if i'm a costume w/ a cello in it. i never worried about that till today. thats what priscilla did. she moved a worry in

choices.say: ur not a costume. the violas clapped. violas NEVER clap. nobody was clapping at the hair.
or give them a quieter picture for 4 min. u can be loud again at 9:05. nobody's grading ur soul.

choices.say: that's the answer. both of them walk in. the hair doesn't get a vote, the cello gets the last word.
go as the whole person. when the bow tie guy asks how it went, tell him it was a signature.
if u still wanna tone it down for one day, that's allowed too. just be honest w/ urself about why.

them: ...the violas clapped. they clapped w/ the hair RIGHT THERE n the lashes n the black dress. they clapped at the cello, but the cello was in the same room as the rest of me. it was all just. in there together
ok. ok ok. im not a costume. im a whole cellist who happens to have 3 ft of white hair. ...i should write that on my arm

choices.say: write it on ur arm. put it in ur case. play like u mean it. that's what the man said.
